function.arguments: {"index": 5, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The customer segment distribution is highly imbalanced between channels: the email channel has a much higher proportion of loyal and returning customers, while paid_search has more new customers. However, within each segment, the average revenue per converted order is very similar between channels (e.g., loyal: $142.10 vs $140.51; returning: $79.78 vs $85.62), and conversion rates are 100% across all segments. This indicates that the campaign itself did not improve conversion or revenue within any segment. The higher average revenue in email is due to its better segment mix, not campaign effectiveness. Therefore, the campaign was not successful in improving outcomes beyond what is expected from targeting. The success claim must be rejected."}
function.name: resolve_finding
